Ordinance No. 2026.G.005 Adopted 6/16/26 AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE HAMBURG TOWNSHIP CODE OF ORDINANCES, CHAPTER 14, ARTICLE III, "WASTEWATER TREATMENT AND ADMINISTRATION," TO CHANGE SEC. 14-47 "DEFINITIONS AND ABBREVIATIONS," SEC 14-49 "POINT SOURCE DISCHARGES", SEC. 14-51 "USE AND CHARGES FOR WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT" AND SEC. 14-53 "TABLE OF UNIT FACTORS," TO UPDATE THE ORDINANCE DEFINITIONS, CERTAIN SEWER USER POLICIES, THE TAP FEE DETERMINATIONS AND APPEALS REVIEW PROCESS AND TO REVISE THE TABLE OF UNIT FACTORS TO REFLECT THE CORRECT REU CALCULATION TABLE.

Ordinance No. 2026.G.004 Adopted 5/7/26 AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE HAMBURG TOWNSHIP CODE OF ORDINANCES, CHAPTER 22, ARTICLE II., "BREACH OF PEACE," TO CHANGE SEC. 22.21 "DEFINITION," AND SEC. 22.23 "SPECIFIC PROHIBITIONS," TO REMOVE REFERENCE TO FIREWORKS AS IT IS BEING ADDED UNDER NEW CHAPTER 22, ARTICLE VI BY THE ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE 2026.G.003.

Ordinance No. 2026.G.003 Adopted 5/7/26 AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE HAMBURG TOWNSHIP CODE OF ORDINANCES, CHAPTER 22, "OFFENSES AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS," BY ADDING ARTICLE VI "FIREWORKS" TO REGULATE THE IGNITION, DISCHARGE AND USE OF FIREWORKS WITHIN THE TOWNSHIP, AND REPEALING PROVISIONS THAT CONFLICT WITH STATE LAW.
